original_card.minimum_viable_unification: A short note presenting the obstruction direction of orbit-descent as ONE no-go family -- O_s-emptiness as the universal descent test -- with three worked finite instances: (a) U(1) phase on a finite ring lattice (vacuum selection needs a declared breaker; the F15a equivariance no-go, opposite-world INELASTIC, the only genuinely load-bearing leg); (b) a finite Gribov-type obstruction (an orbit with no equivariant section, continuum Singer's theorem imported); (c) a NON-QFT F40 descent failure (IEEE-754 / gimbal-lock / lattice-translation) as the anomaly SKELETON, with the QFT case entered only as a declared placeholder; plus a load-bearing scope box per leg. Honestly: a single Lean-certified split-pair criterion that recovers and uniformly audits 'a symmetry cannot break/select/survive itself' folklore, naming exactly which extra datum each account imports -- a RECOVERY + cross-domain audit, not a derivation, with anomaly cancellation explicitly out of scope.
original_card.baseline_comparison: Strictly weaker than every genuine symmetry-unification baseline on physics content, honestly so. The gold standard (B_EW, electroweak SU(2)xU(1) broken by the Higgs) is a single broken symmetry with predicted, measured consequences (W/Z masses, theta_W); U016 produces NO mass, NO force, cannot SELECT a gauge group, and cannot run couplings (B_GUT) -- the gauge leg (R019) is descent bookkeeping with the group imported, and the domain ledger files D_QFT as 'mostly honest-negative' with anomaly cancellation 'structurally inexpressible'. Against a real anomaly account (triangle diagram + index theorem + cancellation fixing SM matter content), F40 supplies only the descent skeleton and imports all content via Bertlmann. The ONE place U016 is not strictly dominated: the F15a equivariant-selector no-go is opposite-world-INELASTIC (SBT could not have retrodicted a symmetric rule cleanly selecting one vacuum), which the textbook 'a symmetry cannot select its own vacuum' folklore states but rarely isolates as a single domain-general Lean-certified criterion. So the contribution is organizational/audit value over a textbook fact, not a unification competitive with EW/GUT/string -- SBT is explicitly 'not in this category' (B_EW vs_sbt).
original_card.why_scientists_care: It converts the folklore 'a symmetry cannot break/select/survive itself; something must choose' into one precise, Lean-certified, domain-general criterion (O_s empty?) with an explicit minimal repair (the declared breaker), making auditable exactly which extra datum any SSB / gauge-fixing / vacuum-measure account must import. The single rigid, opposite-world-inelastic spine (the F15a impossibility of symmetric self-selection) is shown to underlie vacuum selection, gauge-fixing, and the anomaly skeleton, and the analysis surfaces the one decisive upgrade path: an additive/cocycle structure on obstruction sets that would reproduce a real cancellation constraint. Value is to foundations/formal-methods/symmetry-as-redundancy audiences as a clarifying honesty audit, not to a phenomenologist as a prediction.
original_card.stronger_unification: Add a genuine ADDITIVE/cocycle structure on obstruction sets so a union of nonempty obstructions becomes empty under a DERIVED (not declared) condition, reproducing a real anomaly-cancellation constraint (e.g. a U(1) cubic-anomaly cancellation), AND a within-SBT principle that PRODUCES the quotient q / the realized breaker b from substrate data (removing opposite-world tunability). Either would convert two of the three legs from relabeling into derivation; both cross SBT's disclaimed continuum and lens-selection interfaces and are research-grade.

The breaker b is UNUSED in the F15a descent biconditional proof (lines 3092-3106); the 'must import a breaker' bite has to be grounded as the F2 source-refinement, otherwise the headline is asserted not demonstrated.

original_card.fallback: Drop the gauge and anomaly legs to consistency-only INSTANTIATIONS and keep a single-leg deliverable: the F15a equivariant-selector no-go for SSB/vacuum selection (the one opposite-world-inelastic result) with one worked finite instance (U(1) on a ring) and a unification TABLE (not a unification claim) mapping the single O_s-emptiness criterion onto BEC U(1), ferromagnet O(3), Gribov-Singer, hairy-ball/Poincare-Hopf, Buridan, Schelling, Vitali/AC -- presented as a domain-general honesty AUDIT naming exactly which datum each account imports, with a prominent scope box: no formation, no Goldstone modes, no anomaly cancellation, no Born rule. original_card.honest_status_note: Derivability class C: a structural reorganization/recovery, NOT a derivation. Only one of the four legs carries genuine unification weight. (1) SSB no-go (R020/F15a): genuinely Lean-certified 'faithful' and the sole opposite-world-INELASTIC sub-result -- an equivariant deterministic selector under a trivial orbit action lands only in the common G-fixed locus, so no symmetric rule selects one vacuum; but G, the action, the degenerate orbit and the breaker b are all DECLARED, b is UNUSED in the descent proof (so the 'import a breaker' bite must be grounded as the F2 source-refinement), TrivialOrbitAction does the real work, and the F15b formation half is self-axiomatizing over an opaque source -- any 'SBT explains SSB formation' reading is circular and fatal. (2) Gauge-fixing (R019): class-B reorganization, bridge lemma circular as a derivation, opposite-world elastic, continuum Gribov-Singer imported (finite analogue only). (3) Anomaly (R031): bin F -- F40 is the quotient universal property relabeled 'anomaly', GroupLawPreserved is bare action-associativity (NOT a Wess-Zumino cocycle), it ratifies anomalous and non-anomalous worlds equally, and anomaly CANCELLATION is structurally inexpressible (no additive structure), so this leg is skeleton-only. (4) QM measurement (R007): bin E, analogical only, crossing the disclaimed pointer-basis, Born-rule and single-outcome interfaces. Honoring the deflation critique: only the F15a no-go beats it; the gauge and anomaly legs collapse to relabeled quotient-by-fibers and remain opposite-world-elastic. The bridge dictionary is therefore honestly mixed -- one quality-3 direct map (SSB descent), supporting quality-3 operational maps, and quality-0/1/2 analogical maps for the gauge, anomaly-cancellation and QM legs. The bundling of SSB + gauge-fixing + anomaly under one law is a TABULATION over a shared engine, not a per-domain shared ambient algebra; it scores well only on the F15a spine and as an honesty audit, not as a unification competitive with electroweak/GUT/string. All physics content (Singer's theorem, Goldstone/BEC phenomenology, triangle diagram / index theorem / Wess-Zumino cocycle, spin-statistics) is imported.

baseline.how_baselines_handle: The genuine symmetry-unification baselines handle these domains with PHYSICAL content U016 lacks. B_EW (Glashow-Weinberg-Salam): a single SU(2)_LxU(1)_Y gauge symmetry spontaneously broken by the Higgs to U(1)_em, PRODUCING W/Z masses, the photon, and theta_W as predicted, measured quantities -- i.e. it actually breaks a symmetry and selects a vacuum with consequences, exactly the SSB content U016 disclaims (it produces no vacuum, no Goldstone modes, no effective potential). B_GUT embeds the SM group in one simple group and PREDICTS coupling unification + proton decay; U016 cannot embed or select a gauge group (it 'derives' A/G' for any declared G') and NG_LADDER_IDEM forbids any RG-semigroup running of couplings. A real anomaly account (triangle diagram + Atiyah-Singer index theorem + cancellation fixing SM hypercharges / Green-Schwarz) computes the anomaly coefficient and the cancellation condition; F40 supplies only the descent skeleton and CANNOT express cancellation (no additive structure). B_DECOH (decoherence/einselection) DERIVES the pointer basis dynamically; U016's QM leg TAKES the record basis as a free input (MISS_LENS_SEL) -- strictly weaker on the very domain it touches. B_EFT is the natural comparison for the descent/quotient bookkeeping, and it already contains coarse-graining-as-quotient plus genuine RG flow.

Textbook physics states 'a symmetry cannot select its own vacuum' as folklore (Goldstone/Anderson, Gribov-Singer) but rarely isolates it as one machine-checked structural theorem spanning SSB, gauge-fixing, Buridan, Schelling, hairy-ball, Vitali/AC.

U016 bundles SSB (R020/F15a), gauge-fixing (R019/bin E), the anomaly skeleton (R031/bin F), and QM measurement (R007/bin D) under ONE genuinely shared Lean-certified engine: the quotient universal property / orbit-descent criterion (a selectedness/symmetry descends iff its split-pair obstruction O_s is empty). The F15a equivariant-selector no-go (no symmetric deterministic rule selects one element of a nontrivial degenerate orbit; selection requires a declared breaker) is opposite-world-INELASTIC and is the sole sub-result that beats the deflation critique. The other three legs collapse to relabeled quotient-by-fibers and remain opposite-world-elastic: the gauge leg's bridge lemma (gauge orbit = empirical equivalence) is circular and imports G + Singer's theorem; F40 ratifies anomalous and non-anomalous worlds equally and CANNOT express anomaly cancellation (no additive structure -- structurally inexpressible, not merely unproved); the QM leg crosses the disclaimed pointer-basis/Born/single-outcome interfaces. HIDDEN-IMPORT risk is HIGH and includes a load-bearing internal one: the breaker b is UNUSED in the F15a descent proof, so the headline 'SSB must import a breaker' must be grounded in the separate F2 source-refinement, not read out of F15a. Against baselines it is strictly weaker than B_EW/B_GUT on all physics (no mass, no force, no group selection, no running couplings) and strictly weaker than decoherence on the QM leg (imports the pointer basis einselection derives). NET: 6 of 7 anti-superficiality controls FAIL; only 'surprise' passes, and only for the F15a spine. Accept ONLY as the R020-style deliverable -- the F15a no-go + one worked finite instance (U(1) on a ring) + a cross-domain unification TABLE with per-leg load-bearing scope boxes (F15b formation self-axiomatizing; Gribov-Singer/Fujikawa imported, finite analogues only; anomaly cancellation out of scope; no Born rule) -- a recovery + honesty audit, derivability class C, NOT a unification competitive with electroweak/GUT/string.

repair_and_scoring.repair_disposition: REPAIRED BY SPLIT + DEMOTION + RECLASS. The four-domain unification claim does not survive (0/4 skeptics call it a real unification; 6/7 anti-superficiality controls fail). The allowed repairs applied: (i) SPLIT the overbroad four-domain unification into one load-bearing leg + three demoted instantiations; (ii) ADMIT the gauge and QM domains are only sketched/analogical and the anomaly leg is skeleton-only with its load-bearing content (cancellation) structurally inexpressible; (iii) CLARIFY THE BRIDGE by grounding the headline 'must import a breaker' bite in F2 (the source-refinement) and stating in-text that b is unused in the F15a proof; (iv) REPLACE the anomaly/QM analogies with explicit relation-or-scope-box statements naming each imported datum; (v) REMOVE the implicit assumption that the shared engine doing bookkeeping across four legs constitutes unification. What survives is NOT a unification: it is a derivability-class-C RECOVERY of one textbook no-go (F15a equivariant-selector obstruction = 'a symmetry cannot select its own vacuum') plus a cross-domain HONESTY AUDIT table. Because nothing survives AS A MULTI-DOMAIN UNIFICATION, the honest verdict is a downgrade to recovery/analogy: repair_status is 'repaired' only in the sense that a defensible, non-overclaiming deliverable exists (the R020 bin-B note), but is_real_unification stays false. No forbidden moves used: no per-domain assumption added, no terms redefined to force equivalence, no imported physics hidden (every import is named), no duality claimed without a map, no emergence claimed without a limit.

Audit value only.
score_rationale.execution_ease: 5.0 -- F15a, F2, F40 are already proved and Lean-certified 'faithful'; the only new work is one finite worked SSB instance plus careful scope-writing (days to a couple of weeks). The MVU is essentially assembled across existing papers.
score_rationale.plausibility: 4.5 -- The recovered facts (impossibility of symmetric vacuum selection, Gribov-Singer, A/G) are textbook-certain and the quotient universal property is standard mathematics; the assembly cannot be wrong about the structure it reproduces. Capped below 5 only by the unformalized worked instance and the disclaimed-interface touches.
score_rationale.depth_of_unification: 1.0 -- Depth is capped by analogical-only bridges on 3 of 4 legs and by the fact that the shared object does PHYSICAL work in exactly one domain. The legs share an engine but no ambient per-domain algebra; this is shallow tabulation, not deep mechanism-sharing.
score_rationale.breadth_of_unification: 1.5 -- Nominally spans SSB + gauge + anomaly + QM + many toy domains (Buridan/Schelling/hairy-ball/Vitali), but breadth is bookkeeping-only: every additional domain re-imports its full ledger. Genuine breadth is one leg; the table is honest cataloguing.

The breaker b is unused in F15a's proof (load-bearing internal import); G, action, orbit, lens, breaker all declared; gauge/anomaly/QM content imported. The Lean-certified general universal property (not designed around any one domain) earns partial credit above floor.
score_rationale.bridge_explicitness: 1.5 -- CAPPED by failed bridge-map control. Exactly one observable-preserving invertible bridge (SSB order-parameter descent, quality 3); the gauge bridge is circular, the anomaly Fujikawa bridge is unwritten and crosses the disclaimed continuum/path-integral interface, the QM bridge is in no paper. 3 of 4 bridges quality 0-2.

The one rigid result (F15a equivariance corollary) is gated by TrivialOrbitAction and reduces to 'a nontrivial orbit has no equivariant section'; the headline breaker bite is the separate F2 lemma; formation, gauge content, anomaly cancellation, and Born weights are all assumed/imported.
score_rationale.compression_power: 1.0 -- LOW. Real only at the descent-bookkeeping altitude (one O_s test vs four ad hoc no-gos); at the physical-content altitude there is no compression because each leg re-imports its full domain ledger and the legs share no ambient algebra. Anomaly cancellation is structurally inexpressible, so the most load-bearing content cannot even enter the compression accounting.
score_rationale.discriminative_power: 1.0 -- Opposite-world elastic on 3 of 4 legs (F40 ratifies anomalous and non-anomalous worlds equally; F2 flips obstructions post hoc; gauge 'derives' A/G' for any G'). Only the F15a no-go is rigid/falsifiable-in-principle. Zero data points matched, no risky prediction.
score_rationale.audience_legibility: 3.5 -- Lean-mechanized criterion, clear chaining, explicit hypotheses, and honest disclaimers make it legible to foundations / formal-methods / SBT-internal audiences; the subtle points (b unused in F15a; cancellation inexpressible) require careful exposition, and a phenomenologist will see no payoff.
score_rationale.robustness: 2.0 -- Robust as a one-leg recovery + audit once scoped honestly (every cited lemma is Lean-certified at the abstract level), but fragile as anything stronger: the whole multi-domain reading hinges on undischarged/circular bridges and inherited elasticity. The repaired deliverable holds; the unification claim does not.
score_rationale.baseline_advantage: 0.5 -- Strictly dominated by B_EW/B_GUT on all physics content (no mass, no force, no gauge-group selection, no running couplings) and by B_DECOH/einselection on the QM leg (imports the pointer basis decoherence derives). The only non-dominated sliver is isolating the F15a no-go as a single machine-checked criterion -- organizational, not predictive. Capped near floor.

bin_rationale: Bin B (skeptic-resistant structural), borderline B/E. Once the four-domain unification claim is dropped and the deliverable is restricted to the F15a equivariant-selector no-go + one worked finite instance + a cross-domain honesty-audit table with per-leg scope boxes, the result is robust against the adversarial panel: it is the R020 already-repaired bin-B deliverable, internally Lean-certified, and makes no claim a skeptic can demolish. It is NOT bin A (no novel win -- it recovers a textbook fact and imports the physics), NOT C (the abstract lemmas are already certified; this is outward-facing synthesis, not an SBT-internal sanity check), NOT D (no flagship physics), NOT E (it is concrete and shippable, not an open conceptual program). Avoid bin F only because the F15a spine is a genuine, honest, opposite-world-inelastic recovery worth cataloguing; the gauge/anomaly/QM legs, taken as unification claims, would individually be F.

Cheap and honest to ship as a one-leg recovery + audit (the load-bearing lemmas are already Lean-certified; only one finite worked SSB instance and careful scope-writing remain). No predictive payoff, no standing as a new physics or unification result, so it should not displace genuinely fertile candidates.
